hook: Support optimal blood sugar levels, enhance your natural energy throughout the day, and sharpen your mental clarity
claim: Free Sugar Pro is a liquid supplement taken at 1 ml a day, sold to support blood sugar, energy and mental clarity with a proprietary blend of plant ingredients. The seller says it's made in the United States.
ing_note: The official website refers to a 'proprietary blend of plant ingredients' but doesn't list them in text. Ask for the full label before buying, especially if you take diabetes medicine.
use: 1 ml a day, taken directly or mixed with water, alongside a balanced diet and regular exercise.
refund_note: Refunds can be requested by email or toll-free phone.
checks: Without an ingredient list there's nothing to compare against blood sugar research.
'Save $780' figures compare against a list price it isn't sold at.
No study of the product is cited.
verdict: We can't evaluate a blood sugar product that doesn't list its ingredients. Blood sugar supplements can interact with diabetes medicine, so the label matters. If you're concerned about blood sugar, an HbA1c test and your doctor's advice are the place to start.
